investment_theses.thesis: BTC outperforms SPY 2-3x through 2026 as geopolitical escalation (Iran) triggers flight-to-digital-sovereignty narratives, offsetting regulatory headwinds from Chinese AI dominance.
supporting_signals: Trump expects bombing of Iran post-midterms (CNBC/WSJ); Saudi coalition intercepts projectiles — risk-off bid for non-correlated assets
Chinese AI model adoption surge (CNBC) — US tech narrative shifts to digital sovereignty/BTC as uncensorable store of value
Hester Peirce departure (Oct 2, 2026) — removal of crypto advocate introduces uncertainty, but could force institutional portfolio re-allocation into BTC as uncorrelated hedge
Solana 150ms settlement (CoinDesk) validates layer-1 competition; BTC narrative pivots to digital gold/SoV rather than utility, which typically trades stronger in risk-off regimes
investment_theses.counter_view: Geopolitical premium fades quickly if Iran negotiations restart; Chinese AI dominance actually accelerates stablecoin use (Circle/Tether expansion) over BTC; SEC crypto skepticism post-Peirce could trigger regulatory sell-off.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC perps (5-10x leverage, stop at -15%) vs. short SPY or SPY puts; or BTC/SPY ratio call spread (June 2026 $0.018 / $0.025 strikes)

investment_theses.thesis: ETH outperforms BTC (ETH/BTC ratio rises) through Q3 2026 as Ethereum privacy upgrade roadmap (Zcash-style shielding) attracts institutional capital fleeing Chinese model surveillance narratives.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Bitcoin privacy upgrade without rule changes + ETH Foundation privacy roadmap (implicit signal in Ethereum upgrades timeline)
Chinese AI dominance narrative (CNBC) — institutional buyers prefer ETH's smart-contract flexibility over BTC's immutability for privacy-as-a-service use cases
Kalshi SCOTUS case setup (Cointelegraph) — prediction market legality hinges on privacy/anonymity; Ethereum's shielded tx roadmap could position it as compliance-friendly privacy layer
investment_theses.counter_view: BTC privacy upgrade ships faster/cleaner; Ethereum privacy introduces complexity/bugs; Layer 2 solutions (Arbitrum, Optimism) already deliver low-cost privacy; Chinese AI actually benefits ETH's compute-heavy DeFi models.
investment_theses.expression: Long ETH, short BTC equal-weight pairs trade; or ETH call spread (June $3,800 / $4,200) + BTC put spread (June $68K / $62K)
